# rustinion_alert_dependency (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion alert dependency: while the upstream (a router running the agent, an SNMP-monitored router/switch, or an uptime check on an uplink) is down, the alerts of the device (or every device of the group) behind it are suppressed, so one outage sends one alert. Set exactly one of device_id/group_id and exactly one parent_*. Device dependencies replace group ones; with neither, Rustinion uses the device's reported default gateway and LLDP neighbors. Every attribute forces a replace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) The device whose alerts depend on the upstream.
- `group_id` (String) Every device of this group depends on the upstream (unless the device has its own dependencies).
- `parent_device_id` (String) Upstream: another enrolled device (down = its agent hasn't reached Rustinion for 3 minutes).
- `parent_snmp_target_id` (String) Upstream: an SNMP target (down = its latest poll was unreachable).
- `parent_synthetic_check_id` (String) Upstream: an uptime check (down = its latest run failed).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned dependency ID.
